concerns.text: SC‑001 (process up to 30 valid sites within 7 GB RAM) is only verified by a clause‑check in T001; there is no end‑to‑end task that actually runs the full pipeline on the maximum site count to demonstrate compliance.

SC‑003 (no nulls in critical fields such as ‘year’) is only partially addressed by T006’s NDVI schema validation; the climate covariate dataset and other outputs are not checked for nulls in the ‘year’ field, leaving the requirement unverified.
